description: List all contributor-proposed shadow rules: adopted (in production observation-only mode, with 30-day promotion windows) and queued_for_review (proposed but not yet wired). Each row carries proposer handle, frame, source post URL, rule_id, code_location, shadow_log path, review window, and current points. Sourced from /data/contributors.json. Use to see who has contributed encodable frames to the bot.
name: list_adopted_rules
